title.label: 50% off family discount, where’s the individual price?

content.label: 50% off winter discount is somewhat misleading when you’ve applied it only to the family price and removed the individual price is not showing?

I like the idea of the app and it is well put together, but £50 per year is very price for the pro version for what it does. 

It also doesn’t sync with Vitality or Strava so doesn’t work for me.

So how do you offer a 50% discount if you sign up within a couple of day at 24.99 when the app is listed in the App Store as 24.99 your not really offer 50% off are you. 
If you can’t be honest around charging why should anyone trust you with their data?

title.label: Nice UI but that’s about it

content.label: Confused at what this app actually provides that the native apple fitness app doesn’t.  The UI nicely displays your fitness data but the native health app also does that.

I’m only a few days into the trial period but Gentler Streak is already having a positive impact on my health. I’ve been overtraining for years, resulting in frequent periods of injury and this app is bringing everything down to manageable and more importantly sustainable levels. Looking forward to where this takes my fitness and health!

After a week I remain to be convinced. I can see some potentially impressive points, but would like to understand exactly how the system works for your specific needs. For example, when the app states that you are pushing hard and that a break would be beneficial, you then do a workout and it states ‘that’s just what your body needs’. Some of the conflicts are hard to fathom.

A great concept delivered well with plenty of room to grow. This is a feel good, supportive, app which anyone who doesn’t motivate themselves like a marine sergeant will appreciate. I use it every week as an important part of getting fitter sustainably.

Every time I open the app it moves me further into the red stating I’m over reaching despite the fact I’ve not moved, in fact I’ve not exercised in several days. I know I’m unfit but I’m not that unfit. Very disappointed

title.label: Not sure what to make of it

content.label:
I think this would suit teenagers best. I don’t need an app to tell me I’m awesome after an activity. 
Very limited metrics if you’re into that. Lots of facts about food, heart and health but not much I didn’t already know. 
I know that reviews are subjective so I’d say give it a go for the free trial, you may like it.
Non intrusive extra activities  options for being sick or taking a brake excellent connects seamlessly to apple rings brill.

Phone app says I’m smashing it. 
Watch app looks like I’m dead. 

Which is correct? I know, I’ll check my rings. 

Great to have an accurate account of my activities somewhere.
Reported issue with app, developer provided contact details provided, which  are false ! Pity this app had potential !!

Great user interface and lots of simple to understand info. But…. I’ve been running regularly for 2.5 years now and the app keeps telling me ‘I’m Overreaching’  everytime  I’ve completed a run.  The next day I can rest - the day after I can do some gentle exercise - but don’t overdo it. Frustrating!!!

Personalised tips and guidance to make sure you’re exercising at the right level.  It’s like Gentler listens to your body and helps you step up when you need to and slow down before you push too hard and get an injury.

I love the workout summaries, particularly how it shows you the equivalent you’ve burned off in fast food terms.  Funny and motivating.

I also love the monthly and now annual summaries.  Keep up the good work Gentler!

It won’t sync with my health details even though its approved on my iphone settings so is essentially useless i’m afraid. I already reached out and got no reply so I’m not going to do it twice. The ‘is gentler empty’ also yielded no meaningful advice.

This app really hits the spot. I want to get fit and maintain fitness but I am not an extreme exercise person. All the other apps I have tried are quite intimidating and what I wanted was something powerful but gentle - this is it and I strongly suggest that people try it out. You won’t be disappointed.

Such a simple and powerful app. 

No bells and whistles, just one thing that makes a huge difference to my all round well being; the cloud. 

It doesn’t push me to just do more, it nudges me in the right direction. And in my experience the cloud is pretty accurate. When I’ve spent many days towards the top of it I really do start to feel drained, and the nudges it gives me to take it easier come at the right time. 

And when I’m not active enough, the nudges encourage me to do just the right activity. I used to just go to the gym, but this has also got me going out for bike rides and long walks at times. 

You can also turn it off on days when you’re sick and resting so that you don’t feel any pressure to work out. 

As I’ve got a bit older (36 now), balance has become a lot more important, and this app helps immensely with that. 

You’re really paying for the algorithm here, and fair enough, I’m happy to pay for an algorithm that makes a significant difference to my all round well being. 

I imagine the developers are already working on cool updates, but I’d love a bit more flexibility with the statistical analysis, being able to see how my cloud has changed over longer periods of time.

Overall, nice work 👍

I have been struggling to find a fitness app that suits me. 

I was suggested that Gentler would change that for me. There’s always apps where you have to pay subscriptions, however I appreciate that it is free to use. 

Since using this app, with the push notifications, it allows me to stay on top of my daily activity levels. It informs me of how little/high amounts of activity you do and it will send motivating messages to try and push you do hit your goals. 

Being someone who doesn’t have a lot of knowledge in these areas, I like how the app gives you articles to help educate you in the ways of healthy eating and general exercises for me to try. 

I strongly recommend, and I’m sure this app will really become popular if it had more users with the hopes the creator can add more features to the app.

This app works fine for me, import’s early, syncs from my polar watch.  It brings all my data together in a really clear way, no more Apple health confusion.  Summary data is A+, love the little nudges to do more and for me to take some rest.  Cool app, well done yup the devs.

title.label: Was really excited for this app, but..

content.label: I was really excited to get started with this app. However, it consistently crashes after I allow all health data. I have deleted it and reinstalled multiple times but the same issue persists. Is it just me? I hope it can be resolved so I can give an updated review.
Once I allow Gentler access to my Health I get a blank white screen. Tried deleting and reinstalling but I get the same error.
This app doesn’t work on my iPhone 13 with latest iOS 15. It starts but when it tries to access my health data is just freezes. I’ve restarted a few times but it just freezes at this screen.

title.label: Cannot get the app to start properly

content.label: Have tried uninstalling/reinstalling the app 4 times now. Crashes immediately after trying to grant access to Apple Health. What a let down :-(
App doesn’t work for me. When trying to allow access to health data, screen just goes black. Tried deleting and reinstalling but to no avail.
